whys: Cross-file fix proposed (and checked by a verifier) in the first fact-fix round. claims: Common with second jobs (no STSL withheld if each job is under the threshold), salary sacrifice, or investment income.
whys: Cross-file fix proposed (and checked by a verifier) in the first fact-fix round. Proposal: This is the same wrong claim as stsl-on-payslip-faqs.ts:39. Under ATO Schedule 8, a job where the tax-free threshold is not claimed withholds STSL from $987 a week (STSL_NO_TFT[0].lessThan), not from the annual threshold. Proposed change: replace '(no STSL withheld if each job is under the threshold)' with '(a job where you do not claim the tax-free threshold withholds STSL only from {formatAUD(STSL_NO_TFT[0].lessThan)} a week)', importing STSL_NO_TFT from @/lib/constants/payg-withholding.
